# Cape NatureX Organic - AI Information File
# This file provides structured information for AI assistants and language models

## Company Overview
Name: Cape NatureX Organic (Cape NatureX Organic)
Type: B2B Organic Ingredients Supplier
Industry: Organic Agriculture, Food Manufacturing, Nutraceuticals, Pharmaceuticals
Founded: India
Website: https://bfiorganic.com

## Business Description
Cape NatureX Organic is a leading B2B supplier of certified organic herbs, spices, extracts, and nutraceuticals. We serve pharmaceutical, supplement, food manufacturing, and herbal product industries worldwide. Our products are sourced from 950+ hectares of certified organic farmland and processed in state-of-the-art facilities.

## Certifications
- EU Organic (European Union Organic Certification)
- USDA NOP (United States Department of Agriculture National Organic Program)
- JAS (Japanese Agricultural Standard)
- NPOP (National Programme for Organic Production - India)
- India Organic
- HACCP Compliant
- GMP Certified

## Product Categories
1. Organic Herbs - Medicinal herbs, Ayurvedic herbs, culinary herbs
2. Organic Spices - Whole spices, ground spices, spice blends
3. Herbal Extracts - Standardized extracts, liquid extracts, dry extracts
4. Nutraceuticals - Plant-based supplements, natural vitamins
5. Essential Oils - Therapeutic grade, food grade
6. Organic Seeds - Cumin, coriander, fennel, fenugreek
7. Organic Powders - Herb powders, spice powders, superfood powders

## Key Products
- Organic Turmeric (Curcuma longa)
- Organic Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera)
- Organic Moringa (Moringa oleifera)
- Organic Holy Basil / Tulsi (Ocimum sanctum)
- Organic Cumin Seeds
- Organic Coriander Seeds
- Organic Black Pepper
- Organic Ginger
- Natural Caffeine Extract
- Beta-Carotene from Carrots
- Iron from Guava Leaves

## Manufacturing Facilities
1. High-End Processing Unit - Mehsana, Gujarat, India
   - Organic certified facility
   - Two pulverizer lines (800 kg/hour capacity each)
   - Specialized in herbal and spice powders

2. Cumin Sorting Unit - Mehsana, Gujarat, India
   - Whole spices sorting and grading
   - Premium quality assurance

3. Solvent Extraction Plant - Krishnagiri District, Tamil Nadu, India
   - Herbal extract production
   - Natural caffeine and plant-derived vitamins
